edges.notes: newlib provides C and POSIX-oriented interfaces for hosted and bare-metal embedded targets in GCC-class toolchains.
Typical embedded link flows emit ELF objects and images consumed by GNU ld when targeting ELF-capable platforms.
GCC pairs with newlib in many bare-metal and RTOS cross-compilation configurations distributed with embedded toolchains.
GNU ld/as participate in embedded link and startup flows that link newlib objects into final images.
RISC-V embedded GCC toolchains commonly ship newlib for bare-metal and small-hosted targets.
Clang/LLVM embedded toolchains may link against newlib-built sysroots where configured for bare-metal targets.
Embedded C++ toolchains may link GNU libstdc++ above newlib in g++-oriented bare-metal flows when enabled.
Specialized embedded C++ stacks may layer libc++ above newlib-like sysroots in LLVM-centric vendor flows.
libc++abi may pair with libc++ in embedded LLVM toolchains that target newlib-backed environments.
